candidates.change_summary: Return the negation of the stored paused flag instead of its actual value.
Replace the IAccessControl interface id check with the IERC165 interface id check in AccessControlUpgradeable.supportsInterface.
Change the logical OR to AND in AccessControlUpgradeable.supportsInterface, requiring both interface checks to pass.
Delete the IAccessControl interface id check so AccessControlUpgradeable.supportsInterface delegates solely to super.supportsInterface.
Replace the role lookup with a direct return of the admin-role check, making hasRole non-equivalent for all non-admin roles.
